Name: (JA) Bread Themed Recipes
Author: ClumsyLavellan
Description:
[size=4]Adds four new recipes:[/size]
[list]
[*]Naan (wheat flour and milk)
[*]Potato Curry (milk, hot pepper, tomato, potato)
[*]Potato Bread (wheat flour, milk, potato)
[*]BLT Sandwich (potato bread, tomato)
[/list]

[size=4]Food Buffs[/size]
[list]
[*]BLT Sandwich buffs farming
[*]Potato Curry buffs luck, speed, and attack but lowers defense.
[/list]

[size=4]Where to get them?[/size]
[list]
[*]Each food item is sold at the Saloon.
[*]Each recipe is sold at the Saloon.
[/list]

[size=4]Installation[/size]
Download and unzip into your Stardew mods folder.

[size=4]Ideas for the future:[/size]
[list]
[*]Figure out how the heck to add update key
[*]Add gift tastes (I haven't quite figured this out yet)
[*]Adjust the gift tastes of base game Bread so that everyone isn't so neutral about a good crusty baguette
[*]Add new recipes (Sourdough bread, banana bread, bread pudding, etc.)
[/list]

[size=4]Disclaimer[/size]
This is only my second time doing pixel art, and the first was my Icy Abigail Recolor, so it was just adjusting color. My point is, please be kind! I am learning. Let me know if there are any issues and I will do my best to fix them.
